slides.lead: A name you can't say, search or own will cost you later.

slides.h2: If you have to spell it, it's too hard.
slides.lead: People will hear it from a friend, not just read it.

slides.h2: Type it in before you fall in love.
slides.lead: If a big app owns the results, you'll fight for every install.
Instagram, domain, App Store. "Close enough" isn't enough.

slides.h2: The name doesn't have to explain the app.
slides.lead: Your subtitle and first screenshot do that. The name just has to stick.
If they can't recall it the next day, they can't find it.
